graft.title: baseline render writes the repo's LICENSE.md and LICENSES/ into flake template folders
graft.need: In vg-dotfiles, `tend baseline render` writes LICENSE.md and LICENSES/*.txt (four texts) into dev-utils/nix-templates/rust/ and dev-utils/nix-templates/python/ (beside their Cargo.toml and pyproject.toml), saying "vg-dotfiles is copyright ...". Those folders are `nix flake init` templates, copied verbatim into new projects, so every new project would carry vg-dotfiles' license. vg-dotfiles decided (claim 01a199b2-2096, accepted) that template manifests name no license and waived license.manifest there; render ignores that. Needed: a way to keep render out of a subtree (a template folder, or anything a decision waiving license.manifest covers), and render then reporting those files as leftovers rather than Current.
graft.use_case: Today those 10 files sit untracked in vg-dotfiles and render calls them Current; committing them puts the wrong license into every project started from a template, and deleting them by hand is undone by the next render.

answer.text: A real gap: render ignores a decision that waives license.manifest for a subtree. Planned: render keeps out of the subtrees such a waiver covers and reports what it wrote there before as leftovers, not Current. Until it lands, leave those files uncommitted (or delete them); render will stop putting them back.
